headerDisplay: Controls a LEDVANCE Smart+ WiFi E27 A60 bulb over the local network. Needs Python 3 with TinyTuya on this machine: `pip3 install tinytuya`.
footerDisplay: How to get the device ID and local key: [README](https://github.com/adm1nsys/Ledvance-Smart-WiFi-E27-A60-Local-Control#requirements).

virtualId.title: Device ID
virtualId.description: Tuya device ID of the bulb.

localKey.title: Local key
localKey.description: Tuya local key of the bulb.

ip.title: IP address
ip.description: Fixed IP of the bulb — recommended (reserve it in the router). Fill in this or the MAC address.

mac.title: MAC address
mac.description: Without an IP the plugin finds the bulb by MAC in the ARP table; this only works once this machine has talked to the bulb.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (ms)
pollInterval.description: How often the state is read. Each read starts a short Python process; on a small machine a longer interval helps.
